/commit sdlc_planner bug {"number":3,"title":"Accessibility issues on /products/catalog.html - ARIA roles and missing aria-labels","body":"## Issue

Accessibility violations observed on https://www.stage.adobe.com/products/catalog.html

---

### 1. ARIA required children — elements with an ARIA role must contain required child roles

Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children.

**Ref:** https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-required-children?application=AxeChrome

---

### 2. ARIA required parent — elements with an ARIA role must be contained by required parent roles

Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.

**Ref:** https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-required-parent?application=AxeChrome

---

### 3. Resources section — Special offers link missing \`aria-label\`

Screen readers cannot identify the link target for the Special Offers link in the Resources section.

**Expected fix (per Milo pattern):**
\`\`\`html
<a id="item-link"
   href="https://www.adobe.com/products/special-offers.html"
   target="_blank"
   data-level="0"
   aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab">
\`\`\`

---

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All ARIA role hierarchy violations on \`/products/catalog.html\` are resolved (rules: \`aria-required-children\`, \`aria-required-parent\`)
- [ ] Special offers link in Resources section includes \`aria-label\` following the Milo pattern above
- [ ] No new axe violations introduced on the page"}
